title: Common filtered presentation of a morphism of ind-objects
statement:
Let $\mathcal H$ be a small category in a fixed universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the category $\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)$ of small filtered diagrams in $\mathcal H$, with
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)}((C_i),(D_j))=\varprojlim_i\varinjlim_j\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal H}(C_i,D_j).$$
Equivalently its objects are presheaves $\mathcal H^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Set}$ that are small filtered colimits of representables $h_C(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal H}(T,C)$; maps are natural transformations. Filtered diagrams and colimits have the convention of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every morphism $u:A\to B$ in $\operatorname{Ind}(\mathcal H)$ there exist a small filtered category $I$, diagrams $F,G:I\to\mathcal H$, and a natural transformation $v:F\to G$, together with isomorphisms
$$A\simeq\varinjlim_{i\in I}h_{F(i)},\qquad B\simeq\varinjlim_{i\in I}h_{G(i)}$$
under which $u$ is the map induced by the maps $v_i:F(i)\to G(i)$.
